title: Omnisend Review (2026)
intro: Omnisend is evaluated here as email marketing software — Omnisend is an ecommerce-focused email, SMS, and web-push marketing platform with pre-built ecommerce workflows, segmentation, and channel orchestration. Pricing is contact-based with a forever-free plan (250 contacts / 500 emails/mo) plus Standard and Pro ladders; Standard research floor is ~$16/mo at 500 contacts before introductory discounts. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Omnisend when ecommerce email + SMS + push with Shopify-friendly workflows is the job and you want a strong Klaviyo alternative on contact pricing.
verdict: Choose Omnisend when ecommerce email + SMS + push with Shopify-friendly workflows is the job and you want a strong Klaviyo alternative on contact pricing. Compare Klaviyo for deeper attribution, Brevo for send-based value, ActiveCampaign for B2B automation, and Drip for ecommerce CRM/email peers. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
